addFooter.description: Indicates whether to add a footer to the classification banner.

enabledHosts.description: Hosts that display this classification banner. Entries support Helm templating.

pathPrefixes.description: Optional URL path prefixes that display this classification banner on its enabled hosts. An empty or omitted list matches all paths.

text.description: Classification text must start with a known level (UNCLASSIFIED, CUI, CONFIDENTIAL, SECRET, TOP SECRET) and may include additional access or distribution requirements delimited by // (e.g., SECRET//NOFORN). UNKNOWN, SAMPLE BANNER (a demo placeholder), or empty/null are also allowed.

classificationBanners.description: Classification banners to display, selected by host and optional URL path prefix.

classificationBanner.description: Deprecated single classification banner configuration. Use classificationBanners instead.
